title: Brush Your Teeth
subtitle: 考点：建议 / You should brush your teeth twice a day.

dialogue.t: Hello, Amy. Open your mouth, please.
Is there a problem with my teeth?
Yes, a little one. Do you eat a lot of sweets?
Yes, I do. I like them very much.
You should eat fewer sweets. And you should brush your teeth twice a day.
I brush them only once, in the morning.
Please brush them in the evening too. Then your teeth will be fine.

vocab: dentist 牙医 · tooth 牙齿 · brush 刷 · twice 两次 · less 更少 · should 应该 · habit 习惯
